title: Human gate decision
description: One person's answer to one pending human gate, submitted to POST /v1/scientific-runs/{scientific_run_id}/gates/{gate_id}/decision. A model may explain the evidence and propose a value; it may not submit this. The endpoint is reached from a server-side route handler called by a button, and is deliberately not exposed as a CopilotKit action.

decision.description: The three answers src/nodes.py::make_human_gate_node accepts. Anything else is refused here and would be coerced to `stop` there.

rationale.description: Why. Recorded in the run's audit log with the decision.

overrides.description: Values for parameters this gate offered, and only those. Validated by src/registry.py::coerce_overrides — the same function the terminal goes through — so the controller has no second opinion about what a value means. Meaningful only with decision='revise'; supplying them otherwise is refused rather than ignored.

operator_id.description: Who decided. Recorded server-side, never supplied by the model, and never defaulted to anonymous.

expected_generation.description: How many gates this run had opened when the decision was made, derived from the run's own audit log. A decision behind the run's current generation is stale and refused: the alternative is applying an answer to a question that was never shown. The store's unique index on (scientific_run_id, generation) is what actually holds when two arrive at once, so one decision resumes one checkpoint.
